name: waveform-scrub
title: Waveform Scrub
description: A compact audio card with a play button, file name and remaining time above a bar waveform. A white pin can be dragged to scrub, and the bars behind it darken as the track plays.
use: A short recording such as a voice memo or clip needs visible progress and easy scrubbing in a small card.
avoid: Long tracks or precise seeking, since the playhead steps in tenths of a second and the bars carry no timestamps.
a11y: The icon play button has no accessible name or focus ring, and the playhead can only be dragged with a pointer; no reduced-motion check. (keyboard: partial, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card holds a small play icon, the file name and a seconds count. Below sits a pale inner panel of thin grey vertical bars with a white pin on a long stem marking the position.
behaves: Pressing play advances the pin and darkens the bars it passes while the seconds count down. Dragging the pin pauses playback and scrubs to that point; at the end the button becomes a replay icon.
customise: Duration, file name and the bar height array are props; colours, the pin shape and the card radius are fixed in Tailwind classes.
weight: light: A few dozen bar divs and a 100ms interval that only runs while playing.
demo: Standup notes with a 24 second recording and a dictated waveform
issues: The play button is an unlabelled icon with no focus ring.
The bars carry no time labels, so seeking to an exact moment is guesswork.
polishWhy: Tidy compact player with a clear playhead; the plain bars and unnamed icon keep it ordinary.
